definitions.explanation: The act of purchasing a company or business.
The act of paying someone to gain improper influence.

examples.japanese: {大手|おおて}{企業|きぎょう}が{買収|ばいしゅう}した。
examples.english: A major company made the acquisition.

examples.japanese: {敵対的|てきたいてき}{買収|ばいしゅう}から{身|み}を{守|まも}る。
{政治家|せいじか}が{買収|ばいしゅう}で{逮捕|たいほ}された。
examples.english: The politician was arrested for bribery.

notes:
Has two distinct meanings: business acquisition and bribery.

Common expressions:
- {買収|ばいしゅう}する (to acquire, to bribe)
- {敵対的|てきたいてき}{買収|ばいしゅう} (hostile takeover)
- {買収|ばいしゅう}{工作|こうさく} (bribery scheme)
